text:
erin: Quick sync — pen-test retest planning. Need to lock 2 retest slots next week for vuln triage + KMS/RBAC followups. Current blockers: assessor needs read-only KMS wrapping key access to staging readroom, audit logs export TTL >=30d, and confirmation we can re-run exploit against tokenization endpoint in staging. Who can own evidence handoff and preflight?

raj: I can own the KMS grants. Question: ephemeral role (SAML) or service principal for the assessor? Per policy we prefer ephemeral SAML roles. If ok, I'll prepare an IAM role with time-limited assume and a scoped KMS key policy. Planning to hand over creds 24h before slot.

tess: I'll take audit logs. Need the list of indices + time ranges. Also request enabling auth debug for the auth-service for 48h pre-window so we can get full traces. FYI retention increase requires a short ticket to infra — can someone open it?

ben: I created the remediation tracker and tentative slots: Tue 10:00-12:00 PST and Thu 15:00-17:00 PST. Tracker: https://go/redwood/pt-retest-tracker (putting notes there). Can we confirm owners for: evidence upload, KMS grant, RBAC rollback playbook, and telemetry snapshot? I can coordinate ops bridge.

pt_bot: assessor-bot: Received intake from BlueQuall. Report ID: BQ-2026-042. Required evidence: staging logs, KMS access proof, and tokenized payload samples. Upload ETA: next message.

raj: Pushing a grant snippet — we'll use shortlived assume-role with condition scoped to the readroom bucket and a KMS key policy limiting Decrypt/Wrap only. Example (ephemeral role):
```
aws iam create-role --role-name pt-assessor-ephemeral-2026 \
  --assume-role-policy-document file://assume-policy.json

# key policy sketch
{
  "Version":"2012-10-17",
  "Statement":[{ "Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::ASSESSOR:role/assessor"},"Action":["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:WrapKey","kms:UnwrapKey"],"Resource":"*" }]
}
```
I'll post the full ARNs once infra ticket is open.

tess: Re log indices — we need: auth-service-logs, api-gateway-requests, staging-kv-cache, and model-inference-telemetry. Time window: last 72h pretest + during test. Also we should snapshot the audit log export to the evidence bucket with hash for chain of custody.

erin: @raj please also check whether the KMS key is multi-tenant (customer-specific) or a platform-owned key; assessor must not get Decrypt on customer keys.

raj: Confirmed — platform-owned staging key only. Will ensure policy denies Decrypt for any customer-scoped keys.

ben: On the re-run exploit question: legal/assessor signed the safe-ops statement allowing exploit replays in staging. Ops note: make sure rate limits are disabled for the exercise window or we will get noise. I'll coordinate with eng-runtime to whitelist assessor IPs.

oncall: I'll be oncall that Tue. @raj please grant at least 24h before Tue slot, and @tess please confirm logs snapshot readiness 6h prior. If anything slips we default to Thu slot. :thumbsup: 

tess: Opening infra ticket for retention bump now: INFRA-4123. ETA for retention change: 36h if approved. Will post ticket link.

pt_bot: evidence-bot: Uploaded initial report and created evidence bucket folder: s3://pt-evidence/BQ-2026-042. Please use presigned URLs for assessor pulls; do not share long-term keys.

erin: Action items recap: 1) raj -> ephemeral role + KMS policy, grant 24h prior. 2) tess -> audit indices + enable auth debug + snapshot to evidence bucket (attach hash). 3) ben -> confirm slots and whitelist IPs with eng-runtime. 4) oncall -> be primary responder Tue, fallback Thu. 5) pt_bot -> centralize evidence in s3 path.

raj: I'll post the IAM policy + exact ARNs in this thread once INFRA-4123 is created.

ben: Ack — I'll update tracker and send calendar invites once KMS/infra signals go-green.

erin: Thanks team. If anyone hits a blocker post here — small messages preferred.
